context: A mother helps her child put on a traditional outfit for shichi-go-san
purpose: Teach: ゆく/つくっ/みれ/あわせ/かた/オススメ/カ月/イエス

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: さあ、ヒナちゃん、七五三の着物をあわせてみましょうね。
lines.en: Come on, Hina, let's try fitting your shichi-go-san kimono.
lines.style: Warm maternal coaxing, gentle and bright tone.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ママ、この帯のしめかた、むずかしいよ〜。
lines.en: Mom, the way to tie this obi is hard~.
lines.style: Childish whining voice with drawn-out vowel.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おばあちゃんがつくってくれた帯だから、丁寧にやろうね。
lines.en: Grandma made this obi for us, so let's do it carefully.
lines.style: Soft reminder, sentimental and patient delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: みればみるほどキラキラしてる!七歳まであと何カ月?
lines.en: The more I look, the more it sparkles! How many months until I'm seven?
lines.style: Excited child's chatter, bouncy and curious energy.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もう三カ月だけよ。時間が過ぎてゆくのは早いわねぇ。
lines.en: Only three months now. How quickly time slips by.
lines.style: Wistful motherly sigh, tender nostalgic delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ねえ、写真館のあのおねえさん、優しかったよね?
lines.en: Hey, that lady at the photo studio was kind, right?
lines.style: Casual childish question, innocent and curious tone.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ええ、ママのオススメのスタジオなのよ。さあ、髪を整えましょう。
lines.en: Yes, that's Mom's recommended studio. Now let's fix your hair.
lines.style: Encouraging and practical motherly tone, brisk.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 写真撮るとき、英語で『イエス』って言ったら笑顔になるかな?
lines.en: When taking the photo, if I say 'yes' in English will I smile?
lines.style: Playful childish energy, eager and giggly question.
